newsitem.title: FINLAND: Arafat cancels planned Finland stopover-PLO.
newsitem.headline: Arafat cancels planned Finland stopover-PLO.

text.p: Palestian President Yasser Arafat has cancelled a planned brief visit to Finland which had been scheduled for October 29, the head of the Palestinian delegation in Finland said on Friday.
"He has postponed the visit," Zuheir Alwazir told Reuters, but could not say whether the visit would take place at some point in the future.
Arafat had been scheduled to stop over in the Finland for two hours en route from Norway to Ireland but his timetable was too tight, Alwazir said.
